Upstream compiled GridToolBar behavior:

- Collapsible and draggable floating toolbar.
- Manual Update, fullscreen, CSV download, and search controls.
- Toolbar hidden until the grid is hovered.

Project-local manual.3 replacement:

- Render a fixed action bar above the AG Grid column headers when Manual mode is enabled.
- Keep one red 保存 button on the right and an instruction on the left.
- Reserve layout height so the action bar never covers pinned columns or headers.
- Use a red background, white save icon, and Chinese title/aria-label 保存修改.
- Do not render collapse, drag, fullscreen, search, or download controls.

The patch script identifies the single compiled GridToolBar component between
its reviewed minified boundaries and verifies the complete original component
SHA256 before replacing it. Runtime DOM queries and browser-time injection are
not used.
